learning_outcomes.text: Identify contracts within the scope of the insurance contracts standard
Explain the general measurement model and its building blocks
Describe the contractual service margin and how profit is recognised over time
Explain when the premium allocation approach may be used
Describe the variable fee approach for contracts with direct participation features
Outline presentation and disclosure of insurance results

integrative_case: A life-and-general insurer writes long-term participating policies, annual property cover, and contracts with embedded investment components; identify the contracts in scope, apply the general measurement model and contractual service margin to the long-term book, assess eligibility for the premium allocation and variable fee approaches, and outline how insurance revenue and liabilities are presented.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
